title: Does CLO come with a fabric database?
content: **Question** Does CLO come with a fabric database? **Answer** Yes. CLO provides over 300 Fabrics in the CLO Library. You may also purchase other Fabrics in [CLO-SET CONNECT](https://connect.clo-set.com/), Create your own fabrics using CLOFAB, or can purchase CLO Fabric Kit to measure and calculate custom Fabrics and use in CLO. If you are interested in purchasing CLO Fabric Kit, please contact [CLO Global Support Team](https://www.clo3d.com/contact).
content_description: Discover the extensive fabric options available in CLO, including a library of over 300 fabrics, custom creation tools, and purchasing options for CLO Fabric Kits.

title: Configurate Library and Create Blocks
content: **List of Contents** **Structure** **Add Block** **Set Options** ### **Easily and quickly create different variations through previously saved garment blocks within CLO. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133079138201) **[Wath Video](https://youtu.be/CwB8_ad328M) #### **Structure** By default, the Modular Library is organized by **Group** , **Category** and **Style**. This is where all of your blocks will be to mix and match different styles and blocks, here you can also create and save groups, categories, styles and blocks. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133072695193)** **Group and Category** Both of these sections are Folder based; meaning you can bring in folders from anywhere you have access and also create folders anywhere you have access too. **![Modular Library.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133079139865)** Both of these sections are Folder based; meaning you can bring in folders from anywhere you have access and also create folders anywhere you have access too. 1. Click ![add.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133079140633) **Add** button to add your folder to a Group. 2. Double-click the Group folder to navigate into the Category. 3. in Category stage, click ![add.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133079140633) **Add** button and enter the name to add a new category. _**✨Tip:**_ You can copy the path or delete by right-clicking on a Group or Category folder. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133072695193)** **Style** The style is the what all your blocks will be linked to. It is best to think of the different styles as a type of fit so that all your blocks can easily fit together when mixing and matching different blocks. ![Modular Library1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133072702361) 1. Double-click the Category folder to navigate into the Style. 2. Click ![add.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133079140633) **Add** button and set the name and thumbnail. _* If there is a garment in the 3D window, the thumbnail for that garment is automatically registered._ _**✨Tip:**_ You can edit the name and thumbnail, or delete the Style by right-clicking on it. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133072695193)** **Block** These are the different pattern pieces that make up one full style. You can add in multiple patterns for one block, they will be what you will use to mix and create different variations of a style. ![Modular Library2.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133072703897) 1. Double-click the Style to navigate into the Block. 2. Click ![add.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133079140633) **Add** button and click **Add Block Type** option. 3. After setting the information below, and click **OK** button. **Menu** | **Description** ---|--- **Type** | Set the block type. **Tag** | Enter the block tag. If you need to add 2 or more of the same type, categorize them through tags. When the types and tags are added in the same status, the existing block type will be overwritten. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133072695193)** **Line** _(Optional Stage between Category and Style)_ Add a Line tier between Category and Style to create a more precise and detailed structure. 1. Click ![add.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133079140633) **Add** button in the Style stage and click **Group Style by Line** option. 2. In Add Line window, set the name and thumbnail and click **OK** button. → It becomes the upper level above Style in the hierarchy. This allows multiple styles to be grouped under a Line. 3. Click ![add.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133079140633) **Add** button on the right side of the Line to add another Line. _**✨Tip:**_ When clicking **Add Line with Same Style** option, all Styles and Blocks within the selected Line are duplicated and added as a new Line. This can be useful when you want to reuse the same structure but make slight changes to some Styles or Blocks. 4. Right-click on the Line thumbnail to delete the selected Line or, change its thumbnail and name. ### #### **Add Block ** **Auto Modular Labeling** Auto Modular Labeling is based on the results learned from numerous pattern data and analyzes which part of the pattern it is based on only the shape of the pattern. 1. Click ![Button.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33898598442649) **Auto Modular Labeling** button at the top right of the Style stage. → The automatically recognized blocks are highlighted in colors corresponding to each block type. ![Modular Library3.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133072705049) 2. Check all that all patterns in the 2D window are properly assigned to the correct block types using the Modular Creator. 2-1. If any patterns are not recognized correctly, you can manually adjust or relabel them by clikcing **![edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33898591246233)Edit Block** button in the Modular Creator. 2-2. In the 2D window, select the patterns that match the block type you chose and then press the Enter key. _* You can select multiple patterns by holding the Shift key. _ 2-3. In Add Block File window, set the name and thumbnail and click**OK** button. _* The Block thumbnail will automatically be added based on 3D window._ 3. Click ![Button-1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33898598462233) **Save Block** button to set thumbnail image and file name, then click **OK** button. → The Check mark will then be activated to signal that this block is ready. 4. Click**Add** button. 5. After checking whether the block pattern is sewn well with other block patterns, click **OK** button. _* If you need to reset the sewing line, click the Cancel button to correct the[ sewing line](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002324608-Edit-Sewing) and try again._ **📝 Note: **If you are adding a new block based on an existing block file, you can add it directly without going through the Modular Creator by clicking ![add.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133079140633) **Add** button within each Block section, such as Front Body or Sleeves. #### **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133072695193)** **Additional Options** 1. Right-click on the block thumbnail. 2. Click the option if needed. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Delete Selected Block** | Delete selected block. **Share Selected Block** | Share the selected block with other styles. Any changes made to the block will apply to all shared instances. **Change Thumbnail** | Change the thumbnail. **Replace with New Block** | Replace the existing block with a new one. ### #### **Set Options** You can configure Modular options. 1. Click **Settings » User Settings » Other** in the top menu. 2. Configure Modular options if needed. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Modular Access** | **Protect Modular Library to Restrict Editing** | Restrict all editing in the Modular Library to protect its original configuration. **Prevent Blocks Mix and Match across Different Styles** | To protect the users from apply different block fits together turn on the option Prevent Mix and Match. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133079138201) [Watch Video](https://youtu.be/oVK6uCJADzg) When Prevent Mix and Match is active a Warning pop up will appear when a block from one style is being applied to a separate style. **Notch Sewing** | To save out a specific sewing relationship activate the Notching Sewing option. The Modular sewing tags will then follow the notch placements for sewing relationships. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46133079138201) [Watch Video](https://youtu.be/TO8WFMF1s5Y) ###
content_description: Discover how to efficiently utilize the Modular Library in CLO to create, organize, and manage garment blocks, styles, and categories for seamless design variations.

title: Is training available?
content: **Question** Is training available? Where can I learn CLO? **Answer** **CLO for Individual users** provides various online training resources on the CLO web as well as social media. **1.[CLO Academy Online](https://clo3d.geniussis.com/Registration.aspx):** Designed & created by the CLO 3D Design Team. _**Intro to CLO- Basic Apparel Design**_ and _**Intro to CLO- Basic Handbag Design**_ are currently available, with more offerings coming soon. These 2 paid courses go over all the techniques and concepts for creating garments and handbags in CLO. Throughout these courses, there are short quizzes that test your retention of the material. Learners will receive a certification of completion after each course once they are completed. These courses are only available in English at this time. **2.[Beginner's Guide to CLO on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLqL8Ymi3Z68Dqra76a_j0Y_WCcD5WSq4J): **With this free 4-part web tutorial, our expert designers will equip you with all the skills you need to get started using CLO. This training tutorial is made with CLO version 5.0. **3\. Youtube tutorial with sound guide available** * [**CLO features**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lfhIOk6s2Z4&list=PLqL8Ymi3Z68BJ-FaN2fdnUoSZ4qrFqzCk):[ ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lfhIOk6s2Z4&list=PLqL8Ymi3Z68BJ-FaN2fdnUoSZ4qrFqzCk)This playlist includes all the tools in the CLO 3D window, and how to use them * [**CLO tips and tricks**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zYV19dq6NR8&list=PLqL8Ymi3Z68CheCSgecHS1hR0YzAnJcIj): This playlist includes tutorial videos for intermediate to advanced CLO users looking to learn tips for creating and expressing various garments in CLO *You can also search for tutorial videos in various languages on [the CLO Youtube channel](https://www.youtube.com/c/CLO3D). **4\. Additional Online training resources** * **[Manual](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/categories/115000064648-Manual)** \-- Find step-by-step instructions for CLO features. * [Community](https://connect.clo-set.com/community) \-- Gain insights and share your expertise with CLO users. * **[Youtube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/user/clo3dsoftware)** \-- Find more video-based tutorials from beginning to advance. **5\. Webinar and Workshop** You can find bespoke training events by area and language [here.](https://linkin.bio/itsclo3d) **6.[CONNECT](https://connect.clo-set.com/) \- Digital sourcing platform for CLO users** If you'd rather prefer bespoke training, I advise you to reach out to users in[ CONNECT](https://connect.clo-set.com/) as I know some of them offer online training. *CLO offers customized training for **Enterprise clients.** Please reach out to your CLO Business representative for further information, scheduling, and pricing. Please check our [Learning page](https://clo3d.com/en/learning) for more information.
content_description: Discover a variety of online training resources and tutorials to enhance your skills in CLO, including paid courses, free YouTube guides, and community support for both beginners and advanced users.

title: Arrange Pattern with Arrangement Points/Flip Wrap Direction
content: **Objective** Arrangement Points are created on the basis of the Bounding Volume surrounding the Avatar, and are arranged on the Avatar according to the Bounding Volume's curves. **※ Note:** Precise arrangement is available by using [Gizmo](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002802728) or [Property Editor](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115004877468) even after arranging with Arrangement Points. **Location** Avatar Display ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005508288/AVT_03Points_Off.png) **Show Arrangement Points** **Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline: Avatar Display ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005508288/AVT_03Points_Off.png) **Show Arrangement Points** → The Arrangement Points appear around the Avatar. 2. Select a Pattern and hover the mouse over an Arrangement Point. → A preview of the Pattern placement is being displayed (ver2.4.0). 3. Select a desired Arrangement Point. → The center of the Pattern is now being placed according to the selected Arrangement Point. → Symmetric Arrangement occurs as long as the Patterns and Arrangement Points have symmetry applied (ver3.0.0). **※ Note:** **Flip Wrap Direction** Patterns that the length are longer than the Bounding Volume, such as cuffs, get arranged spiral. Right-click on patterns in the 3D window ▶ Click **Flip Wrap Direction** to flip its direction.** **
content_description: This web page provides guidance on how to effectively use Arrangement Points to position patterns on an Avatar based on the surrounding Bounding Volume, with additional options for precise adjustments using Gizmo or Property Editor.

title: Auto 3D Arrangement (ver 7.1)
content: **Objective** Automatically arrange patterns around the Avatar in the 3D window. Based on the results learned from a number of pattern data, Auto 3D Arrangement analyzes where the pattern will be arranged only with the shape of the pattern. It is recommended to apply symmetry and sewing before Auto 3D Arrangement, as symmetry and sewing information of patterns as well as shapes are referenced for more accurate arrangement. **Location**** ** Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ **Auto 3D Arrangement** 3D Toolbar ▶ **Auto 3D Arrangement** **Operation** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. → Auto 3D Arrangement Window appears. 2. Click the Proceed button. → Patterns with high accuracy are arranged in order, and the patterns arranged in each step are classified by color and transparency. 3. If you want to check the arrangement result of each step, Click the Back and Next buttons. → Return to the Back and Next Steps. 4. Click the OK button to complete the Auto 3D Arrangement. ※Note: Patterns that are too small in size or analyzed in the same location may not be automatically arranged with lower accuracy.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide a comprehensive guide for using the Auto 3D Arrangement tool to efficiently and accurately arrange patterns around an Avatar in a 3D environment.

title: [2D Tool] Free Sewing
content: ### **Objective** Freely establish Sewing Lines on Pattern outlines and Internal Shapes/Lines. **Location** Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶**Free Sewing ** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001254128/_______.png) **Free Sewing** ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ **Free Sewing ** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001254128/_______.png) **Free Sewing** 2. Click, drag and click on Pattern outline or Internal Shape/Line to establish the start and end points of the first half of the seam. 3. Similarly, click again on another Pattern outline or Internal Shape/Line to establish the start point of the second half of the seam. → Drag the mouse cursor as a blue point appears guiding the length of the first half of the seam. 4. The mouse cursor snaps to the blue guide point. 5. Be mindful to make the Directional Notches parallel to each other and click to complete the second half of the seam. **※ Note:** * The face of the Directional Notch of a Sewing Line defers depending on the order of establishing the start and the end point of the Sewing Line. * Right click while establishing the Free Sewing Line to enter the desired length of the Sewing Line in the Create Sewing Line window. * Use the shortcut to establish M:N sewing lines. For more detail, please reference [M:N Free Sewing](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000497727).
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for using the Free Sewing feature in Clo3D to easily create sewing lines on pattern outlines and internal shapes.

title: Set Fabric Materials
content: #### **List of Contents** Fabric Properties Material Type Base Color Normal Map Displacement Map Opacity Reflection #### **Express texture or pattern of the fabric. ** #### #### **Fabric Properties** 1. Click a fabric in ![Fabric Tab.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38101235323545) **Fabric** tab in [Object Browser](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/115000374247-%EB%AC%BC%EC%B2%B4%EC%B0%BD-Object-Browser-). 2. Set the material properties in Property Editor. #### #### **Material Type** 1. Set the appropriate [CLO Material Type](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115015998728-Material-Type). #### #### **Base Color** **Color** 1. Set the [color](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047316974-Fabric-Color) of the fabric. **Base Color Map** 1. Click the **Open** button to apply the Base Color Map. **📝****Note:** Through the option of [User Setting](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002563607-Set-Default-Files), you can convert the color profile of the image to sRGB when loading textures. 2. Set the Recolor option as needed. **• Desaturate ** Desaturate the entire Base Color Map to remove color and convert it into grayscale or black and white. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38107403704601) ![Label_Final.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38107403705241) **• Color Switch** Easily and quickly switch the color of solid fabric to a new one without losing the accuracy of the chosen color. ![Switch Color.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38116673801369) ** 📝 ****Note:** It is recommended to use the [Texture Editor](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360053351314-Texture-Editor#Click4) if the Base Color Map contains multiple colors, as it may not be switched properly. Please note that this Switch option is not synced with the Switch option in the Texture Editor. #### **Normal Map** Express uneven texture more realistically. 1. When a texture is applied, Normal Map is generated by adjusting the Intensity. 2. Or click the **Open** button to manually apply Normal Map image. #### #### **Displacement Map** Express thickness or bumpiness of fabrics or textures. You can find more detailed information [here](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025439933-Displacement-Map-ver5-1-0). #### #### **Opacity** **Opacity** 1. Adjust the Opacity value to apply transparency to the fabric overall. **Opacity Map** Adjust level of transparency using a grayscale image map. 1. Set the mode to determine whether the map's alpha value is encoded in the RGB channel or the alpha channel. 2. Click the **Open** button to apply Opacity Map. #### #### **Reflection** **Roughness** 1. Set whether to adjust the Roughness with the intensity value or apply it as a specific map. 2. Adjust the values to express fabric gloss. 3. Check the Invert option to make the shiny parts becomes dull and vice versa when using the map. ** Reflection ** 1. Adjust the intensity value to express fabric reflection. **Metalness** 1. Adjust the value to apply metallics to the fabric overall. 2. Or click the **Open** button to partially apply metallics using a grayscale image. * The white parts of the map appear metallic. **📝****Note:** • When working with **Metalness Map** , control **Roughness Intensity** and **Reflection Intensity** level that are suitable for the metallic texture. (e.g. Roughness Intensity 10, Reflection Intensity 90) • For the non-metallic areas (matte), assign the same metalness map to **Roughness Map,** and turn on **Invert**. #### ****📝******Note:** When clicking the Back/Side tab and turning off '**Use Same Material as Front** ' option, you can apply different materials to the back and side of the pattern and also you can set **'Use Same Color as Front'** option. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide to adjusting and applying various fabric properties, including texture, color, opacity, and reflection, to enhance the realism of fabric designs in CLO 3D.

title: What kinds of assets are provided by CLO?
content: **Question** What kinds of assets are provided by CLO? **Answer** CLO provides many types of assets by default, allowing users to make a great range of 3D Garments without limitation. Provided assets include, but are not limited to, male, female, child Avatars, basic T-shirt Patterns, accessories such as shoes and hair, accurately emulated Fabric, trims, and hardware like zipper puller, rings, and more in the CLO Library. You can refer to the **[new Library Manual](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/38939105493785-New-Library-Beta)**. You need more than what we provide? Please visit **[CLO-SET CONNECT](https://connect.clo-set.com/) **and purchase as needed. CONNECT provides a wider variety of assets, available for purchase or for free, to help you work more efficiently in CLO. You can download and instantly use various patterns, fabrics, accessories (including hangers and racks), avatars, motions, poses, and background scenes directly in your CLO projects. In your library of CLO, you can go to the CONNECT tab and search for what you are looking for. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/50423988342681)
content_description: Discover the diverse range of default and purchasable 3D assets available in CLO to enhance your garment design projects effortlessly.

title: Edit V-Ray Camera Properties
content: #### **Create a dynamic image for 3D garments with enhanced camera settings replicated from real-world film/DSLR/video cameras: ISO, f-number, effects, and more. ** **Location** The ![Camera Properties On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44250068287897)**Camera Properties** can be accessed through several paths: \- Main Menu ▶ Render ▶ Render ▶ Render window toolbar ▶ **Camera Properties** \- Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ Preferences ▶ Camera Properties ▶ **Default Camera** \- Object Browser ▶ Scene tab ▶ Environment ▶ Camera ▶ **Default Camera** \- right-click pop-up menu in 3D window ▶ Camera Properties ▶ **Default Camera** **Lens** **Default/Panorama (Render Only):** Select a view type between default and panorama. **Field of View:** Sets a view range by adjusting the camera lens's field of view. **View Orientation** **Type:** Select a view type between Spherical (object-centered) or Absolute (X-, Y-centered). **Spherical** **Distance:** Zooms in and out. **Horizontal Angle:** Rotates the camera view horizontally. **Vertical Angle:** Rotates the camera view vertically. **Absolute** **Horizontal Angle:** Pans the camera view horizontally. **Vertical Angle:** Pans the camera view vertically. **Clipping Plane** **Near:** Assigns the nearest distance that the camera can capture. **Far:** Assigns the farthest distance that the camera can capture. **Physical Camera** **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Exposure** | Configure the amount of light penetrating into the camera to change the brightness. To do so effectively, use the **Exposure** option instead of adjusting the brightness of the **[V-Ray Lights](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014899168-Edit-V-Ray-Light-Properties)**. **ISO** | Adjust the sensitivity of the film. A small value results in a darker image; a high value in a brighter one. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360016901473) **F-Number** | Adjust the openness of the aperture. A high value results in a darker image; a small value in a brighter one. ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360016147354) **Shutter Speed (1/s)** | Adjust the shutter speed with the unit of 1/s. When the shutter speed is 1/30s, the shutter is open for one-thirtieth of a second. To replicate the same effect, you should type in 30. The amount of the penetrating light decreases with an increased number of shutter blinks. Therefore, a high value results in a darker image; a small value in a brighter one. ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360016147414) **Depth of Field** | Configure the depth of field by adjusting the camera's focus. The depth of field is dependent on both the **Focus Distance** and the **F-Number**. **Viewpoint Focus** | ## ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44250068288665) ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/50223447482521)[ Watch Video](https://youtu.be/iflI4v36pi4?feature=shared&t=455) Each [**Custom View**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115004420828-Custom-View) can be rendered with an individually set Depth of Field. 1\. Enter the desired Focus Distance value in the Custom Views fields. 2\. Or, adjust the Focus Distance directly during Interactive Render to automatically apply the value by adding a new view or overwriting an existing view in the Custom View window. ** Focus Distance ** | Set the camera's focus point as needed. Use the **F-Number** option to adjust the focus length (clear area), starting from the focus point. A larger **F-Number** results in a larger clear area is; a smaller number in a narrower one. As adjusting the focus length with the **Focus Distance** is not intuitive, using the **Focus by Left Click** option is recommended. ** Focus by Left Click ** | Click to set the focus point. When the focus point is selected, the Focus Distance is calculated automatically. ** Effects ** | Stretch the image either vertically or horizontally.
content_description: This web page provides comprehensive guidance on creating dynamic images for 3D garments by utilizing advanced camera settings inspired by real-world photography techniques.

title: Rendering Thickness
content: **** Set the rendering thickness for the patterns. Rendering thickness value is only visible and does not Simulate as the thickness value space out between Fabrics. **** 1. Select the pattern to set the rendering thickness. _* To see the rendering thickness,[3D Garment Rendering](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115001025968-3D-Window-Display-Icons#Click3) Style must be set to one of the thick-surface styles. _ 2. Set the thickness options in Property Editor. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Add'l Thickness - Rendering** | Enter desired rendering thickness value. This value is for rendering purposes only and does not affect collisions. However, when exporting, enabling the Thick option will export both the Side and Back Mesh and UVs **✨Tip:** Collision thickness can be adjusted at [Simation Properties ▶ Add'l Thickness - Collision]. **Extrusion Direction** | Specify the direction in which thickness is applied based on the Pattern Plane. **Both** | Apply thickness evenly to both the front and back based on the Pattern. **Forward** | Apply thickness forward. **Backward** | Apply thickness backward. Toggle each side on or off to determine whether to generate the Mesh. **Front Face** | Specify whether to generate the Front Face. **Back Face** | Specify whether to generate the Back Face. **Seam Face** | Specify whether to generate the surface where the stitched and bonded parts meet. **Side Geometry** | **Curvature (%)** | Specify the curvature. **Resolution** | Set the number of subdivisions. **Doubled Sided** | Apply the same curve to both sides. **UV Expansion**** **** **| ## ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45512137895065) **![Youtube_Icon__1_.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/29851942890777)**[Watch Video](https://youtu.be/iflI4v36pi4?feature=shared&t=401) The side and back UVs can be edited in [UV Editor](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360053418574-UV-Editor-Mode). **Back Face** | Switch the UV from the front to the back. **Side Face** | Expand the UVs to include the side.
content_description: This web page provides guidance on setting the rendering thickness for patterns in garment design, detailing options for thickness application and UV management without affecting collision properties.

title: Adjust Avatar Size
content: #### **List of Contents** ▪ Open Avatar Editor ▪ Adjust Size ▫ Overall Body Size ▫ Cup Size ▪ Adjust Shape ▪ Open/Save AVS File #### **Create an avatar with your own measurements.** **As CLO Avatar Editor is powered by thousands of real body scan data, even measurements not assigned by users automatically adjust to the most realistic body shape.** #### #### **Open Avatar Editor** 1. Open [CLO Avatar File (.avt).](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/115002687268) 2. Click the Main Menu » Avatar »**Avatar Editor** menu. #### #### **Adjust Size** ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38383105947289) #### ** Overall Body Size ** Sets the overall body size of the avatar. It is automatically adjusted based on actual body shape data according to the entered width and height measurements. 1. adjust the size if needed. **Option** | **Description**** ** ---|--- **Size**** **** **** **| **Width**** **| **Bust** | Set the overall body width based on the bust circumference. **Under Bust** | Set the overall body width based on the under bust circumference. Set the type of Width to Under Bust, then adjusting the detailed measurements of Bust allows you to change the cup size while maintaining the overall body shape. **Weight** | Set the overall body width by entering the weight. **Height** | **Total Height** | Enter the height measured from the ground to the head. **📝****Note:** Since each person has a different head size, it is most accurate to create a overall body shape based on HPS Height or Inseam, rather than Total Height, which is less accurate and not recommended. **HPS Height** | Enter the height measured from the ground to the neck. **Inseam** | Enter the height measured from the ground to the crotch. **Detailed Mesurements** | Click the link button to unlink and modify the width and height while keeping detailed measurements. Adjust each specific circumference, height, and length by entering values directly. A small error may be generated when entering measurements, and the error appears when you click the Measures on the 3D Avatar. **Movable Measure** | Select the Edit Measure Tool (Avatar) » Click the Circumference Measure (black solid line) for Under Bust, Waist, High Hip, Low Hip, and Thigh » Drag it to the desired position to set the baseline for resizing. **📝****Note:** After changing the position, right-click on the Measure to reset it to its original position. **![set.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33892941272089)** **Set Details** | Select the Detailed Measurement to enter. The more Detailed Measurements you select, the more unnatural it may appear, as the measurements are not automatically adjusted and remain fixed to the entered values. **![list.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33892956958489)** **Show All Measurements** | Check the measurements for all parts. #### ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38383105947289) #### ** Cup Size ** #### ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44157364716953) ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45044161771161)[ Watch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WUzYuqeVNFo) Set bust cup sizes using custom measurements. * The cup size is available only when the width is based on the under bust circumference. 1. 1. Click **![set.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33892941272089)Set Details** button. 2. Activate **Cup Size** option by clicking the checkbox. 3. Set the cup size count. 4. Name each cup and enter the difference between the bust circumference and the under bust circumference. 5. Click **![Exit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45045480083097)****Exit to Complete** button. 6. Simply change the desired cup size in the Cup Size added under the Size section. **📝****Note:** The set cup size is saved in both the avatar (AVT) and avatar size (AVS) files. #### **Adjust Shape** 1. Adjust the Avatar size and shape. **Option** | **Description**** ** ---|--- **Shape**** **| **Hands & Head** | Adjust the size of the avatar's hands and head. **Crotch** | Adjust the crotch gap. For male avatars, Crotch Volume can also be adjusted. **Breast** | Achieve various breast shapes by adjusting the Breast Shape, Space and Height. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45044161771161)[ Watch Video](https://youtu.be/5GIh4LQsUZY) ![Breast.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38383634568985) **📝****Note****:** If you enter the Apex to Apex or HPS length and then adjust the Breast Space, discrepancies and distortions may occur in the entered length. #### **Hip** | #### ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44157364716953) #### Achieve various hip shapes by adjusting the Hip Dips and the Volume. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45044161771161) [Watch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XZDyPYgyvnI) #### ![Avatar Hip.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44157369904409) **📝****Note****:** Hip Shape is available only for Female and Male. #### #### #### **Open/Save AVS File** 1. Click the Save or Open button in the Avatar Size Editor to manage the size data. **📝****Note****:** Avatar size files may not be fully compatible between the latest version (2024.1) and previous versions (2024.0 and below). It is recommended to use files matching the version. #### **Go back to the List of Contents**
content_description: "Create and customize your avatar with precise measurements using the CLO Avatar Editor for a realistic 3D representation."

title: How to uninstall CLO completely
content: In the process of Live Update or alternately using multiple CLO versions, various files and settings that make up the CLO software may be damaged, causing the CLO software to not operate normally. You can solve this problem by completely uninstalling the CLO software and configuration files and then reinstalling with the latest CLO installer. **Note** * Only the files and settings that make up the CLO software are deleted, and user-created files are remain. * Before uninstalling the CLO software, please back up your working files to a safe place. * If you have changed the CLO install path, find the path and delete it. * * * **Windows** **1 Logging out of CLO Software or deactivating from website** * Under the CLO Settings menu, select Logout or Deactivate License. * [Deactivate CLO from website](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500000942261) **2 Uninstall CLO software** * Go to Windows Start > Settings > Apps or Installed Apps > CLO Software and click Uninstall. * If you have installed different product types or multiple versions, uninstall all CLO software using the above method. ![001_Win_Uninstall.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/16260393832729) **3 Delete Registry** * Windows Search > Type _'Registry Editor'_ > open as administrator > delete the CLO registry. * Path: _Computer\HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\CLO Virtual Fashion_ * If you don't see the CLO product name in the Windows Registry, all have been deleted. * Note that deleting the CLO product key from the Windows Registry will make CLO behave as if it was installed for the first time. If you want to completely reset user settings of the CLO software, you can use the method of deleting only the registry keys of CLO. ![007_Delete_CLO_Registry_Keys.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49131892784665) **4 Delete CLO install folder and Assets folder** * Even after deleting the program, additional downloaded files and some configurations may remain. * The default install path is C:\Program Files\CLO{product name}, select and delete the entire CLO folder. **5 Delete CLO Assets folder from Windows shared folder** * The default install path is C:\Users\Public\Documents\CLO, select and delete the entire CLO folder. **6 Delete hidden CLO files** * Some CLO configuration files are stored as hidden files. * Go to Windows File Explorer > Options > Folder Options. * Select 'Show hidden files' as shown below and click the 'Apply to Folders' button. ![007_Folder_option.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/16264058474777) * Go to C:\Users\\{Windows user name}\AppData\Local, select the CLO folder and delete it. ![005_hidden.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/16263600237849) * * * **Mac** Note: before uninstalling the CLO software, please back up your working files to a safe place. **1 Logging out of CLO Software or deactivating from website** * From the SETTINGS Menu, Log Out or Deactivate License of CLO. The application will Quit. * [Deactivate CLO from website >](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500000942261) **2 Uninstall CLO software** * Open the MAIN APPLICATION folder on your computer. NOT the Application folder in the User Folder. * Find the CLO, Right-Click & Move to Trash. Only do this if you want to fully uninstall CLO. ![008_macOS_uninstall.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/16557180465689) **3 Delete CLO Assets folder** * To remove all the CLO Assets, go into your DOCUMENTS Folder. Delete the CLO Folder there. ![009_macOS_assets.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/16557381041177) **4 Delete hidden CLO files** * Go to your HOME Folder, use Column & navigate to the Go Menu. Note the contents on the menu and in the items in the Home folder. Release the menu. ![009_macOS_Home.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/16558744414617) * Type SHIFT + COMMAND + PERIOD (.) this will activate hidden items. * A few things will show up in the Applications folder. Return to the Go Menu and note that “LIBRARY” is now visible and there are more Items available in the Home folder. Some are dimmed. These are items that are normally hidden. * Go into the LIBRARY folder and delete the CLO folder under the APPLICATION SUPPORT folder. ![010_macOS_Libarary.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/16558775926553) * Next, still in the Library, go into Preferences. * Select all the files that begin with COM.CLO. (The full name will differ depending on which version of the software you downloaded and installed). * Right-Click on one of the selected files and Move to Trash. * Empty your Trash. ![011_macOS_hidden.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/16558970688025) **Note** * If you have deleted only the CLO Preferences files, when you start CLO again it will be as if it is opening for the first time; you will need to input your login information, add your Favorites to the Library and customize your User Settings.
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide for completely uninstalling and reinstalling the CLO software to resolve issues caused by Live Update or multiple version conflicts.

title: Edit Simulation Properties
content: ### **Objective** Configure the simulation properties for advanced scene settings. **Location ** Object Browser ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/36782471113753) Scene ▶ Environment ▶ **Simulation Properties** ** Operation** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. → The simulation properties appear in the Property Editor. 2. Refer to the below table and edit the simulation properties as needed. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Preset** | Instead of selecting the [simulation mode](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000304968-Simulation) from the 3D toolbar, you can choose predefined presets here. Normal, Fitting, and GPU simulations are primarily used. **Time Step** | This determines the time values calculated within the simulation engine. The smaller you set it, the more sophisticated it will be, but it will also require more calculations and will, resultingly, be slower. The default values are recommended. **Number of Simulation** | When calculating cloth simulation for a given time step, this denotes how many substeps one simulation calculation is divided into. For example, if you are calculating a time step of 0.03 and number of simulation is 10, the actual time step will be 0.003. Simulating multiple times with these smaller time intervals ensures both more numerically accurate results and stable collision handling, but takes much longer. **CG Finish Condition, CG Iteration Count, CG Residual** | Clothing simulation is the process of solving a large linear system. Large linear systems can be solved using a numerical analysis method called conjugate gradient method (CG). CG improves the accuracy of the answer through iterative calculations. The condition for CG ending can be set by the number of iterations or when the error (=residual) falls below a certain value. Iteration: Because it repeats only a certain number of times and ends unconditionally, it is faster but may be less accurate. Residual: It is slower but can be more accurate because it stops when the error falls below a certain value. **Self Collision Iteration Count** | Defines the number of collision calculations for the clothing. More collision calculations produce more precise results, but they are also slower. Please use the default value. **Air Damping** | The resistance that the garment receives from the air. **Gravity** | Defines the most important gravity values in your simulation. If this value is adjusted, simulation results will become unrealistic. Please use the default value, unless you want to, for example, create a weightless simulation. **Number of CPU in Use** | This determines the number of physical cores within the CPU that will be used for the simulation. CLO can technically use up to 12 cores, which are automatically defined based on your computer. Even if it is a high-end CPU with 16 cores, up to 12 can be used. This may vary depending on the CPU manufacturer and actual CPU products. This value is best also left at default. **Nonlinear Simulation** | Linear or non-linear is an important factor in all fields of computer graphics, simulation, rendering and engineering. By analogy, the real world is non-linear, but computer implementations are linear. Nonlinearity is a technique that makes things look very real, and simulating them this way is sophisticated, but slow. If Fitting simulation is run, this option is selected. t's slower because it's more complicated and requires a lot of calculations. **Ground, Avatar-Cloth Collision Detection, Self-Collision Detection, Proximity Detection** | All of these are intended to simulate collisions and friction between the clothing and the avatar. Because CLO calculates numerous contacts and collisions between the fabric and the body, the simulation looks natural and realistic. It is recommended that these values are also left at their default. **※Note:** **Use the Open & Save buttons on the top of the Property Editor to save, open, and reuse the settings.**
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide for configuring simulation properties in advanced scene settings to enhance the realism and accuracy of clothing simulations.

title: CLO File Formats
content: **See below a list of CLO-internal file formats.** **Type** | **Format** | **Description** ---|---|--- **Arrangement Points** | *.arr | Arrangement points are the blue points that may be distributed around an avatar and are used to easily arrange patterns around it. They are created on top of bounding volumes (*.pan) covering the surroundings of the avatar. **Alvanon Avatar** | *.avac | Alvanon avatar file format. **Alvanon Avatar Pose** | *.avacp | Pose file for Alvanon avatars. **Avatar Size** | *.avs | Contains avatar size information. A compatible avatar file (*.avt) must be loaded before opening an avatar size file. **Avatar** | *.avt | Contains all information related to avatars (model/mesh, sizing data, pose, motion, shoes, hair, glasses, bounding volumes, arrangement points...) **Avatar (encrypted)** | *.avte | Encrypted CLO avatar file. **Avatar (encryption permission)** | *.avtp | Permission key file to unlock encrypted avatars. **Buttonhole** | *.bth | Contains type, size, color, etc. of buttonholes. **Button** | *.btn | Contains type, size, color, etc. of buttons. **Camera Motion** | *.cak | Contains camera motion animation data. **User Settings Configuration** | *.cfg | Stores user configuration settings. **Camera Projection** | *.cmp | Contains the camera's field of view information (distance, etc.) **Camera Transformation** | *.cmt | Contains camera view information of the 3D garment window. **Camera Properties** | *.cpt | Contains camera properties. **Graphic Properties** | *.grp | Contains the properties of a placed graphic. **Hand Pose** | *.hpos | Save or load only the hand pose instead of the entire pose of an avatar. **Body Measurement** | *.mea | Avatar body measurement file. **Joint Motion** | *.mtn | Contains avatar motion information. As with the pose file, it can only be saved on COLLADA file avatars with joint and animation information. **Pattern** | *.pacx | Contains pattern pieces only without any simulation data. **Bounding Volumes** | *.pan | Bounding volumes are the green cylinders or boxes covering each part of the avatar, and each end of such a shape is connected to an avatar's joint. Therefore, even if a pose is changed, the cylinders/boxes adjust to the changed pose. **Pose** | *.pos | An avatar's pose can easily be changed with this file. Avatar poses from other software can only be saved if the avatar is a COLLADA file with joints. **Print** | *.prt | Contains any property values (configuration, color, maps...) of a print added to a fabric via the print feature in the Object Browser. **Physical Property** | *.psp | Contains detailed values of a fabric's physical properties. **Puckering Style Preset** | *.ptp | Saves puckering style presets used for topstitching or seam visualization. **Render Camera Properties** | *.rcp | Contains camera properties for rendering scenes. **Simulation Property** | *.smp | Contains settings for simulation. **Topstitch** | *.sst | Contains type, number of lines, thread thickness, SPI, length, etc. **Trim** | *.trm | Contains all trim object data. **Light Properties** | *. vlp | Defines light properties for rendering scenes. **Image/Video Properties** | *. vmp | Includes image or video rendering settings. **Render Properties** | *. vrp | General render settings including resolution, quality, and environment. **Avatar Accessories** | *.zacs | Hair, shoes, glasses, jewelry, etc. compatible with an avatar. **Modular Block (OLD)** | *.zblc | Deprecated; modular block format used in earlier versions. **Custom View** | *.zcmr | Custom camera views saved by the user for consistent shot framing. **Fabric** | *.zfab | Contains any property values (maps, color, physical properties...) of a fabric. **Modular Template (OLD)** | *.zmdr | Deprecated; format for modular garment templates used in earlier versions. **Modular Block** | *.zmod | Modular block design file used for creating reusable garment modules. **Garment** | *.zpac | Contains 3D garments in their simulated state, 2D patterns, seamlines, fabrics, other materials, etc. **Zipper Puller (OLD)** | *.zpl | Deprecated; zipper puller model data. **Project** | *.zprj | Compresses the various files used for garment creation into one, containing the AVT file that has avatar-related data, the ZPAC file that contains garment-related data, as well as animation data if applicable. **Zipper Puller** | *.zpu | Zipper puller texture mapping file. **Zipper Slider** | *.zsd | Zipper slider model data. **Scene & Props** | *.zse | For stages and props to add to the 3D scene. **Zipper Slider** | *.zsl | Zipper slider texture mapping file. **Zipper Stopper** | *.zsp | Zipper stopper geometry file. **Zipper Slider & Puller** | *.zss | Combined zipper slider and puller mapping file. **Render Properties (all combined)** | *.zvrp | All-in-one render properties file combining light, camera, image/video, view settings, etc. ****
content_description: Explore a comprehensive list of CLO-internal file formats used for avatar and garment design, detailing their types, formats, and descriptions.

title: How to Speed Up CLO
content: In this article, learn how to improve the performance of your CLO software and keep it optimal. The overall performance of CLO is affected by computer specifications, maintenance, and the number of programs running, but it also varies depending on user settings and garment file properties within the software. Problem Situations ![001_Windows.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/36782529045401) * CLO software becomes unresponsive or quits unexpectedly. * It takes a long time to open the file. * It takes a long time to save the file you worked on. * Simulation slows down or quits unexpectedly. * Rendering freezes or quits unexpectedly. * * * Show Frame Rate ![001_FPS.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49482274897561) * **Go to the top menu > Settings > Display > Environment > Show Frame Rate**, and you will see several numbers in the lower left corner of the 3D window, including FPS (Frames Per Second), which shows real-time results of the simulation speed of your garment and the overall performance of your computer. * The screenshot above is the result of putting a halter-neck dress on a CLO avatar, adjusting the particle distance to 10, and simulating in Normal-CPU mode. It consists of 6 patterns, 0 trims, 20 sewing lines, 15261 vertices, and shows a speed of about 52fps in Normal (Default) simulation. * Each user's perceived performance is different, and it is advantageous to do actual garment editing and design work under high frame rate conditions. * * * User Settings ![002_AA.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49482274910873) * **Graphic Options > Antialiasing**: For low-end computers with only Intel Graphics as well as Macs with integrated memory of 8GB or less, set the Antialiasing value to x8 or lower. The higher the anti-aliasing setting, the smoother the images and videos that eliminate jaggies will be, but more video memory and high-performance graphics processing will be required. * **Normal Blending, Default Rendering, Image Resolution Setting** : These are options that determine the various methods and modes for configuring graphics, images, textures, and screens, and the CLO team recommends using them in their default unless there is a special purpose. * Please note that starting with CLO 2024.2, the VBO setting has been removed and integrated into the CLO software as _"**VBO_enabled**."_ VBO allows you to store vertex data in GPU memory, enabling fast 3D rendering. All modern GPUs support this, so users do not need to manually turn it on or off. ![004_Auto_Save.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/36782529053337) * **Default Files > Auto Save > Time Interval (min**): Starting with CLO v6.1, it is set to 10 minutes by default. If you set this value as low as 1 or 2 minutes, file writing may occur frequently, slowing down CLO's speed. * * * File Properties ![005_ParticleDistance.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/36782512763673) * **Particle Distance; default setting 20** * Lower particle distance allows for more realistic garment expressions, but the number of vertices that make up 2D patterns and 3D garments increases dramatically. As a result, the amount of calculations that need to be done on a computer can increase by several to tens of times, which in turn slows down simulation and garment editing. * Rather than setting the particle distance low from the beginning and then creating the garment, it may be more efficient to lower the particle distance after the design stage. ![006_topstitches.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/36782512764569) * **Excessive use of OBJ topstitching; change to type "texture"** * OBJ topstitching is a method of dividing the mesh of narrow and long areas into finer pieces than the mesh of regular patterns. Therefore, if you use a lot of OBJ topstitching, the amount of mesh calculation increases and CLO's speed may slow down. * For faster work, it is advantageous to use OBJ topstitches only on the areas where it's absolutely necessary and apply texture-type topstitches to the remaining areas. ![004_animation.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49482337576601) * **Project file containing animation** * In the case of project files containing animation recordings or files containing motion created in other programs, the file size can be several to tens of times larger than a typical CLO project file. So it may take longer to read, edit, and save files. In particular, files containing animation and motion have a file structure that is relatively easy to damage, so handle them with care. ![008_Avatar.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/36782529061273) ![007_Trim.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/36782512766617) * **Project file containing custom avatars or heavy OBJ trims** * The two pictures above are examples showing the mesh count of the custom avatar's hair and of the trim attached to the garment. * The software is optimized for avatars provided by CLO. If your project file contains heavy custom avatars or heavy OBJ or FBX objects, it may run slowly. * If you're experiencing slow behavior when opening and working with certain project files, check to see if they contain custom avatars or heavy trim objects. * **Ultra-high resolution image files** * When using ultra-high-resolution textures and graphic images to create and express realistic 3D garments, more computer processing and file input/output are required. This leads to performance and speed issues: * When using image files larger than 4000x4000 pixels as textures or graphics images, you may experience speed issues on and in certain computers and CLO usage scenarios. If speed problems occur due to the texture or graphic image you are trying to use, lower the resolution of the images. * **Export files at high resolution** * In file export scenarios, including VRAY rendering, setting the target resolution too high can cause CLO to become very slow or freeze. * In the case of VRAY render, increasing the resolution increases rendering time, and in some cases, rendering may stop due to insufficient video memory. Start with a small image size and default resolution and gradually increase the size to find the optimal render settings for your computer. * When using features such as PDF export and 2D snapshot export, we recommend the default setting of 127 ppi. If it exceeds 200 ppi, both image size and file size may increase tremendously, and file saving may fail in the PDF file format. * **Project file created in an old CLO version** * Due to a flaw in certain versions of CLO software, project files created in those versions may experience speed issues when opened in newer versions. Re-saving in the latest version may resolve these issues. * * * Simulation Modes ![003_Simulation.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49482337579417) * **Normal (Default)** * This is the basic simulation mode for most cases. * **Fitting (Accurate Fabric)** * This feature is designed to produce extremely precise and accurate clothing simulation results. It performs at least 5 times more calculations than the Normal simulation, so it runs slower. * **Animation (Stable)** * This is a preset optimized for garment animation recording. While other simulation modes focus on representing a stationary avatar and the clothes worn on it, this one is designed to simulate the natural movement of clothes following the motion of the moving avatar without losing the sophistication that can be relatively lacking. * **CPU vs. GPU** * CPU simulation is the default and works well for all garments and use scenarios. * GPU simulation is only enabled on Windows computers which equipped Nvidia graphics card, and although there are differences depending on the garment and its properties, it is up to 20 times faster than the CPU-based simulations. When tested on commonly used project files, it is approximately 2 to 5 times faster. ![005_animation_split.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49482274914713) * **Animation Recording** * CLO's animation recording simulates garments that change slightly at each frame and saves the results as a file. Therefore, the CPU-GPU simulation principle described previously is applied as is. You can change animation recording presets and various properties, for high quality animation, use the default 'Animation (Stable)'. * The more flashy and heavy the garment is, and the more total frames of animation there are, the larger the animation data generated, the more hardware resources are required. If you need to record a very long and complex animation, it may be advantageous to record the entire scene by splitting it into about 100 frames as shown above. * * * See also * [CLO System Requirements](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000307168) * [Visual C++ Redistributable download (Windows only)](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000730068) * [Graphics card problems and troubleshooting](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000296768) * [Install CLO with administrator privileges](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/17074279996697) * [How to prevent CLO File corruption](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/23206278838681) * Internet speed has little to do with CLO performance. CLO software connects to the internet only when logging in, logging out, downloading assets, uploading and downloading CLO-SET files, and delivering crash logs to the CLO server when a crash occurs. * Computers are sensitive to heat, so if the CPU and GPU temperatures are too high, the computer will not perform properly. To maintain optimal computer performance, periodic cooler cleaning and maintenance are required. If you are unfamiliar with these tasks, contact your company's IT department. * If you are using a laptop, we recommend that you connect the power cable to maintain maximum performance. If the laptop is running on battery mode, it may drop to 1/4 of the maximum performance.
content_description: Discover essential tips and techniques to enhance the performance of your CLO software, ensuring optimal functionality and smoother garment design workflows.

title: Change Email from CLO-SET
content: ## **Objective** Understand how to change your email address, and the following implications of changing your account email. 1. Change Email vs. Email Switching 2. Ground Rules for Change Email 3. Change Email Guide * General Flow * Confirm License Info 4. [Change Email Implications](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9876556955663-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QPN6FK48VSWVVB87JZJ82Y) 5. [Troubleshooting](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9540709934223) ## **Details** #### **1) Change Email vs. Email Switching** **Change Email** | VS | **Email Switch** **(when the 'new email' is already on CLO-SET)** ---|---|--- ![change email.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713825390873) | ![email switch.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713825393817) * **Change Email** : Change your CLO-SET Integrated account email. Changing the CLO-SET email will also update the connected CLO license information if any. Please find instructions below on the Change Email Guide. * **Email Switch** : Email Switching is for users hoping to connect their existing CLO license with a different CLO-SET email account. This feature is not available yet. For such requests, please [submit a ticket](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new?ticket_form_id=9530590112143). #### **2) Ground Rules for Change Email** * Accounts registered as Enterprise or Academic on CLO software cannot use 'Change email' feature. * If the email address you want to change TO is already registered in CLO-SET, you cannot override an existing account. Please refer to the [troubleshooting guide](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/34340082505497-Troubleshooting-Email-Changes-on-CLO-SET) for further steps. * Your CONNECT account is the same as CLO-SET account. The two services share account information. #### **3) Change Email Guide** 1\. Click on the 'Change Email from CLO-SET' button on Account page and visit 'My page' on CLO-SET to start the change email process. ![image \(185\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713838778521) 2\. If your CLO-SET account is also active on CLO service, please note that the account information on respective services will also be updated. Click 'OK' to proceed. ![image \(186\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713825398681) 3\. On the following screen, please type in the new email address to be used. Click 'Send' to receive an email with the verification code. [Not receiving verification emails?](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9021987313039-Not-receiving-verification-email) 4\. Once the verification is complete, you will see the final modal on the right. Please go back to the sign-in page, and start signing in with the new email address. Please also carefully read the implications of changing your emails. ![image \(187\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713838791449)![image \(188\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713825407897) 5\. **[Important]** Active License found under your New Email Address If the there is/are active CLO license under the 'new email' you typed in, your CLO-SET account will now be integrated with those License information. One of the two modals below will be displayed with the list of Licenses to be connected. ![image \(191\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713825411353)![image \(192\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49713825413785) *Signing again with your current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)) will create a 2nd CLO-SET account after changing your account email to [newemail@clo3d.com](mailto:newemail@clo3d.com). *If you would like to keep the license under the current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)), please use the '[Email Switching](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9876556955663-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QNCTQSZMYFJFQ43ZPVV7T3)' feature instead. #### **4) Change Email Implications** * **Impact on Request and Community History** Changing your email address will disconnect the history of your requests and community activities. This includes comments, request history, and other related data, which will no longer be associated with your new email address. * **Account Type** Enterprise user email changes are not allowed. Please make the change through your Company ID. It is possible to change your personal email to a corporate email, but the account type will not change. If you wish to change your account type from personal to enterprise, please contact our support team. * **Billing Email Matching** If your billing email matches your CLO-SET account email, it will automatically update when you change your CLO-SET email. However, if they don't match, your billing email will remain unchanged. * **Plan Type Considerations** If you have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), you won't be able to proceed with the email change. You may need to retain your current email or consider cancelling your subscription to initiate the change. If you don't have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), your user type will automatically change with the email change. (Individual↔️Student) However, be aware that this may impact the available subscription plans. Only plans corresponding to your updated user type will be available for purchase. * **Change Email between CLO global and China Websites** When you change your email on the CLO Global website, you cannot change it to the email registered on the CLO China website. **5) Troubleshooting** For various reasons, email changing is not supported systematically for certain accounts. Please follow the [Troubleshooting Guide](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/34340082505497-Troubleshooting-Email-Changes-on-CLO-SET) to reach the support team. * * * Before changing your email address in CLO-SET, please consider these factors to ensure a smooth transition and avoid any unexpected issues. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to [Contact Us](https://clovf.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on changing your email address for your CLO-SET account, outlining the necessary steps, implications, and troubleshooting tips to ensure a seamless transition.
